output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The transfer function allows a user to transfer more tokens than the balance, causing a potential trap.
The sell function allows a potential trap due to integer overflow, allowing a potential attacker to set the balance of any user to any value.
The buy function allows a potential trap due to integer overflow, allowing a potential attacker to set the balance of any user to any value.
The setMinBalance function allows attackers to set a new minimum balance for all accounts, aka the 'setMinBalance' vulnerability.
